test_title: PYST 24: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Read the following sentence and select its future tense form from the options given below:

Ramya finished her dissertation early.

options.text: Ramya had finished her dissertation early.
Ramya will finish her dissertation early.
Ramya has finished her dissertation early.
Ramya is finishing her dissertation early.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Ramya will finish her dissertation early .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the past tense: **"Ramya finished her dissertation early."**
 
• To convert it into the future tense, we need to use **"will" + base verb**.
 
• Therefore, the future tense form of the sentence is: **"Ramya will finish her dissertation early."**

Correct sentence: *Ramya will finish her dissertation early.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Past Tense Form:**
 
 
• **Example:** Ramya finished her dissertation early.
 
• **Usage: **Describes an action that was completed in the past.
 
 
 
• **Present Tense Form:**
 
 
• **Example: **Ramya finishes her dissertation early.
 
• **Usage: **Describes a habitual action or a general truth.
